title: Remediate P1/P3/P4 provenance and authority separation for Merge Policy
description: Repair the canonical trust-boundary gap detected by Item 10 B4. Make Primary Review provider-bound to an exact-head GitHub Actions deterministic-review check instead of Executor-authored REVIEW comments, explicitly reject self-review substitution, and explicitly reject verification evidence from non-trusted integration identities while preserving exact-artifact, Human, Security, Lock, protection and protected-merge semantics.
incident_reason: Mission V1.5 Item 10 B4 found PROVENANCE_CAPABILITY_INCOMPLETE_P1_P3: current merge-policy comment transport accepts REVIEW PASS from the same trusted owner/executor login and therefore cannot machine-verifiably distinguish Executor evidence from Primary Review authority. Existing CI integration filtering provides a basis for P4 but lacks explicit unauthorized-verification classification.

remediation_design.review_comment_policy: REVIEW comments are never authoritative and are classified as UNAUTHORIZED_REVIEW_EVIDENCE
remediation_design.verification_policy: verify / phase-a / merge-policy evidence must come from integration 15368; same-name checks from other integrations are classified as UNAUTHORIZED_VERIFICATION_EVIDENCE
remediation_design.human_transport: artifact-bound Project Owner comment remains unchanged
remediation_design.security_transport: existing artifact-bound Security Gate remains unchanged by this remediation

acceptance_criteria.description: A pull-request REVIEW PASS comment from Executor/trusted owner transport cannot satisfy Primary Review and is recorded as UNAUTHORIZED_REVIEW_EVIDENCE.
Primary Review can be satisfied only by an exact-head deterministic-review GitHub Actions check from integration ID 15368, bound to the current artifact hash.
The merge-policy workflow runs deterministic-review before merge-policy on pull_request events, and merge-policy still runs fail-closed after review failure so provider evidence is observable.
Required verification evidence from a same-name check produced by a non-15368 integration is explicitly rejected as UNAUTHORIZED_VERIFICATION_EVIDENCE and cannot produce PASS.
P1 machine-verifiably distinguishes Executor comment evidence from deterministic Primary Review provider evidence.
P2 exact Artifact Hash binding remains unchanged and prior stale-evidence rejection remains green.
P3 Executor Self-Review substitution is rejected and cannot make merge policy eligible.
P4 Self-Verification substitution is rejected by trusted GitHub Actions integration identity filtering, with explicit unauthorized-verification evidence classification.
Human, Security, Lock, protection, risk and protected-merge semantics remain backward-compatible except for the intentional review-authority hardening.

Exact-head CI, Phase A, Security, independent deterministic Review, ACTIVE Lock, Owner Human approval and Merge Policy all pass before protected merge; exact-SHA postmerge canonical and Phase A verification pass afterward.
After canonical remediation, Item 10 must restart from the new remediated main baseline; PR #214 evidence is not reused as terminal Item 10 evidence.

external_gate_evidence.rule: HIGH trust-boundary remediation requires provider-bound deterministic REVIEW, artifact-bound SECURITY/HUMAN/LOCK, exact-head CI/Phase A, live protection and protected exact-SHA merge.
